C1801.title: 7 Detained for Running Online Gambling Ring Under World Cup Guise
keywords: 7 Detained for Running Online Gambling Ring Under World Cup Guise
C1801.summary: Xi'an Weiyang police cracked an online gambling case tied to the World Cup in just 19 hours, with seven suspects criminally detained. The syndicate used sports events to set up betting operations and attract participants.
